subject: asp-es
title: ASP.------TH.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 189 (EVOL-27). ASP-ES (aspect essence) (the title writes ASP) is the subject; TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT (social reality). From SOC-RT: EXT-F (extended functionalism) and DEC (decentralization). From EXT-F: LANG-DY (language dynamics) and INFO-DS (information dissemination). From INFO-DS: IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism). From DEC: MPT (manipulation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
